logic_group.name: libplist OpenStep parser
logic_group.description: The OpenStep property list parser in libplist is a recursive descent parser that converts OpenStep-formatted text into a plist node tree. It supports complex nested structures such as dictionaries and arrays, along with primitive types like strings (with support for various escape sequences and octal/hex character codes) and hex-encoded data blocks. The parser is robust, featuring comprehensive whitespace and comment skipping (both single-line and block comments), and can automatically handle both standard OpenStep files and the 'strings' file variant used for localization.
